sensors.name: obstacle sensor on the left LEFT

control_flow: avoidWalls: if the right light is below 60 %, check the front and left obstacle sensors; otherwise call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 %; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.

likely_intent.description: Do not hit the walls of a tunnel while driving through it.

decision_points.condition: the right light sensor (RLIGHT) reads below 60 %

branches.outcome: the right light is below 60 %: it checks the obstacle sensors
the right light is 60 % or more: it calls driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: inside dim light: an obstacle is ahead, else on the left

branches.outcome: an obstacle is ahead: it turns left 15°
no obstacle ahead, an obstacle on the left: it turns right 15°
neither is seen: it calls driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor (LLIGHT) reads below 70 %

branches.outcome: the left light is below 70 %: it drives forward at 30 %
the left light is 70 % or more: it calls stopAtWall
an obstacle is ahead: it stops
no obstacle ahead: it calls followLine

scenarios.coded_response: It turns right 15° in steps; otherwise it drives forward at 30 %.
scenarios.initial_condition: In a tunnel that bends to the right, in dim light, the left wall comes in front of the robot's left side.
scenarios.trigger: The left obstacle sensor sees the tunnel wall.
scenarios.title: Turns away from the left wall in a right bend
assumptions: You didn't say where in the tunnel it should go, only that it shouldn't hit the walls.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It steers away from the wall and gets through the bend without touching the tunnel walls.

scenarios.coded_response: It reads only the left and front obstacle sensors: with nothing front or left it drives forward at 30 %; with a wall directly ahead it turns left 15°.
scenarios.initial_condition: In dim light in a tunnel: a straight tunnel with walls along both sides, or a bend to the left with the right wall in front, or a wall directly ahead.
scenarios.trigger: The robot drives in the tunnel; the right wall or a wall ahead is in view.
scenarios.title: Stays clear of the tunnel walls on the right or straight ahead
assumptions: You didn't say which way it should turn, only that it shouldn't hit the walls.
A wall directly ahead in the dark is treated as a tunnel wall.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It never touches the tunnel walls; it steers away from a wall in front and stays clear of the side walls.

scenarios.coded_response: It calls driveInTheDark; with bright left light it checks the front obstacle sensor: it stops at a wall ahead, otherwise it follows the line by curving left on black and right otherwise.
scenarios.initial_condition: In bright light, with a wall ahead or a line under the robot.
scenarios.trigger: The right and left light sensors read bright light.
scenarios.title: In bright light, a wall ahead or a line

uncertainties: Your sentence only says not to hit tunnel walls; it doesn't say what the robot should do in bright light, at a wall in the light, or on a line.
The program reads the left obstacle sensor but not the right: in a bend to the left it may miss the right wall.
The program's light thresholds switch inside a tunnel, not at its opening.
